parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: $('LIB NormalizeInput').first().json.rawMessage, historyContext: $('LIB NormalizeInput').first().json.historyContext, sessionId: $('LIB NormalizeInput').first().json.sessionId, history: $('LIB NormalizeInput').first().json.originalBody.history }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ ApiCode: $('LIB ConfidenceDecision').first().json.intent, params: { ...$json.cleanParams, '@Username': $('Parse User Info V5').first().json.userProfile.realUsername } }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: $json.status, message: $json.message, data: $json.data, count: $json.count, apiCode: $json.apiCode, items: $('LIB ConfidenceDecision').first().json.items, action: $('LIB ConfidenceDecision').first().json.action, username: ($('LIB NormalizeInput').first().json.originalBody?.username || 'QLBH013.MED'), intentParams: $('LIB ConfidenceDecision').first().json.params, _debug: { confidence: $('LIB ConfidenceDecision').first().json.finalConfidence, matchedBy: $('LIB ConfidenceDecision').first().json.matchedBy, decision: $('LIB ConfidenceDecision').first().json.decision } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'info', message: $json.askMsg || 'Dạ, anh/chị có thể nói rõ hơn không ạ?', data: [], count: 0, apiCode: 'ASK_CLARIFICATION' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'info', message: $json.errorMsg || 'Dạ, thông tin chưa đủ để tra cứu ạ!', data: [], count: 0, apiCode: 'VALIDATION_ERROR' }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    I.ItemID, 
    I.ItemName, 
    I.Unit, 
    COALESCE(I.NguyenGia, 0) AS Price,
    COALESCE(S.QuantityinStock, 0) AS TonKho
FROM CF_ItemTbl I
LEFT JOIN IV_StockTbl S ON I.ItemID = S.ItemID
WHERE I.ItemID IN ({{ $json.items.length > 0 ? $json.items.map(i => "'" + i.itemId.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') : "''" }})
